verified_by: public HuggingFace and GitHub APIs, unauthenticated, no token used

model.note: counts cover the two .tar weight artifacts; the repository also holds README.md and .gitattributes (1550 B combined). Sizes and hashes read from the HF blobs API at the pinned revision; neither tar was downloaded.

audio_encoder.why_not: models/network.py:40 guards the download with os.path.exists(pretrained_encoder_path). The configured value is the repo id 'facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h', which is not a filesystem path, so the guard is false and line 43 runs instead: Wav2Vec2Config.from_pretrained('configs/wav2vec2_config.json') followed by Wav2Vec2Model(config) — a randomly initialised encoder whose weights are then expected to come from the LAM checkpoint.
audio_encoder.consequence: derived, not measured: the fine-tuned encoder weights must be inside LAM_audio2exp_streaming.tar. Confirming that requires opening the 373 MB tar and was deliberately not done at L0.
audio_encoder.hazard: if a directory literally named 'facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h' ever exists in the working directory, the guard flips and the model is loaded from disk instead. Behaviour is path-dependent.

files_that_would_be_required_if_the_guar.name: model.safetensors
files_that_would_be_required_if_the_guar.note: transformers 4.36.2 prefers safetensors when the safetensors package is installed, which it is (0.8.0)
